zh: 只关心三个数的和，与下标顺序无关，所以可以先排序；每个三元组按值排序后仍只被数一次。
排序后固定最小的数 a[i]，在它右侧用左右双指针找另外两个数：若 a[i]+a[l]+a[r]≤t，则 r 换成 l 与 r 之间任何位置都成立。
排序；对每个 i 令 l=i+1、r=n−1；当 l<r 时，若三数和≤t 则答案加 r−l 并让 l 右移，否则 r 左移。和最大约 3×10⁹，计数也可能超过 32 位，都用 64 位整数。
en: Only the sum of the three values matters, not their original positions, so you can sort first; each triplet is still counted exactly once by its sorted values.
After sorting, fix the smallest value a[i] and run two pointers l and r to its right: if a[i]+a[l]+a[r] ≤ t, then replacing r with any position between l and r also works.

Sort; for each i set l=i+1 and r=n−1; while l<r, if the sum is ≤ t add r−l to the answer and move l right, otherwise move r left. Sums reach about 3×10⁹ and the count can exceed 32 bits, so use 64-bit integers.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Sort the array, fix i, and scan the remaining elements with two pointers l and r. If the sum is ≤ t, every position between l and r can serve as the third element, so add r−l; otherwise decrease r.

## Correctness

After sorting, when a[i]+a[l]+a[r] ≤ t holds, it also holds for every k in (l, r], and each such k forms a different triplet. If the sum is too large, only shrinking the largest element can make it feasible again. Every i<j<k is counted exactly once.

## Complexity

Time O(n²), space O(n); the site adds n ≤ 2500.
